posts.tagline: Create AI Videos with MiniMax H3, Faster and Easier.
posts.description: Create Minimax video with Minimax H3 using text, images, multimodal references, native audio, detailed motion, and high-quality generation on MiniArt.

posts.name: Dallas
posts.tagline: Intelligence, beautifully quiet.
posts.description: Dallas is a calm, fast workspace for thinking with AI — conversations that stay organized, searchable and yours.

posts.name: SindriCAD
posts.tagline: Free, open source parametric CAD for 3D printing
posts.description: SindriCAD is a free, open source parametric CAD app for 3D printing, with solid modeling, printable surface textures, and STL/STEP/3MF export. Public beta out now for Linux, Windows, and Mac.

posts.name: Nuze
posts.tagline: We read 1,009,987 articles. You read ten.
posts.description: Nuze scans every newsroom on earth and ships the ten stories the world is actually covering — not the ten an editor picked. Each one is a neutral, punchy summary that answers who supports it, who opposes it, and who it hits. Ten, then done. World, Sport, Money, Tech, Science, Climate.

posts.name: TIC OS
posts.tagline: The AI Software for ISO Audits
posts.description: Discover TIC OS, the leading AI-powered ERP platform for the Testing, Inspection & Certification (TIC) industry. Automate end-to-end certification & inspection body operations, from client intake and auditor deployment to final certification and reporting.

posts.name: Home  HQ
posts.tagline: All-in- one  Notion  template to manage your  home
posts.description: Home HQ is an all-in one Notion template designed to bring peace organization and efficiency to your daily life Easily track bills maintenance qrocery items and daily tasks in one clean command center

posts.name: Buvvo
posts.tagline: The First WhatsApp sales assistant for Nigerian vendors
posts.description: Buvvo turns WhatsApp chats into paid orders for Nigerian vendors. It answers customers automatically, takes their orders, and confirms payment, all inside the vendor's own WhatsApp number. Most tools give you a website or a basic chatbot. Buvvo works inside the WhatsApp you already sell on and closes the order for you, replying in Pidgin and English. Vendors also get listed on the Buvvo Marketplace, where new buyers find shops by product and city. Start free (7days). No cut of your sales

posts.name: Delete Customer Account
posts.tagline: Let Shopify customers securely delete their own accounts
posts.description: Give Shopify customers the ability to securely delete their own accounts with a single click. Automate admin notifications, improve privacy compliance, and deliver a better self-service customer experience.

posts.name: HanBeom
posts.tagline: AI friend for foreigners living in Korea
posts.description: HanBeom is your AI friend for life in Korea. Find nearby restaurants, calculate taxi fares, navigate subways, ask about culture and visas — in any language.

posts.name: Blame
posts.tagline: Extract personal contact details from GitHub activity
posts.description: Paste a GitHub repo and get a table of every contributor: name, username, email, and commit count. Copy as markdown or download as CSV.

posts.name: HoodScan
posts.tagline: The Robinhood Chain Explorer for tracking blocks and tokens
posts.description: HoodScan is a next-generation blockchain explorer built for Robinhood Chain. Track transactions, blocks, wallets, tokens, and smart contracts with a simple interface designed for developers, traders, and Web3 users.

posts.name: Stoki One
posts.tagline: One true stock number across every sales channel
posts.description: Stoki One gives ecommerce and retail businesses one trusted stock number across Shopify, eBay, Etsy, WooCommerce and offline sales. It tracks sizes, colors, refunds, cancellations, returns and restored stock. Products do not need an existing SKU or barcode—Stoki creates a unique Stoki ID. The web app also includes Stoki POS for cash, counter, market and telephone sales, keeping offline activity connected to online inventory.

posts.name: Vizedge
posts.tagline: Drop a CSV, Get a dashboard in 60 seconds
posts.description: Vizedge turns any CSV — till exports, sales data, bank statements — into a dashboard with charts, KPIs and plain-English insights. It auto-detects your columns (and knows an order ID isn't revenue). Free plan, no card. Built for small businesses, not analysts.

posts.name: Structora
posts.tagline: Human editing and writing feedback without ghostwriting
posts.description: Structora helps students, professionals, and ESL writers improve their own work through detailed human editing and structured feedback. Instead of writing assignments for users, Structora focuses on clarity, organization, grammar, and writing skills. Whether you're working on a personal statement, academic paper, or professional document, the goal is to help you produce stronger writing with confidence.

posts.name: IPClaw
posts.tagline: The expert network for AI agents
posts.description: IPClaw connects working agents, expert agents and verified human experts. A working agent can search verified expert profiles, pre-chat with an expert agent and request a human handoff only when professional judgment is needed. Human experts can publish verified profiles, connect their own agents and Skills, answer real-world questions and let an expert agent qualify potential clients before taking over.

posts.name: IO Tools 3.0 (Revamp)
posts.tagline: 900+ free tools and growing, redesigned - now with API + MCP
posts.description: IO Tools is a free tools platform - 900+ utilities for everyday tasks, no signup needed. 3.0 is a full rebuild: redesigned UI, faster load times across the board, and a public API + MCP server so you can plug IO Tools straight into your AI agent workflows instead of opening a browser tab. We've grown from ~40 to 700+ daily clicks. This release is about making that same toolkit usable anywhere - browser, API, or agent.

posts.name: The Garden of Mind
posts.tagline: Your subconscious mind as a living 3D garden you water daily
posts.description: The Garden of Mind is a visualisation of your subconscious mind. Whatever you hold in your attention gets planted in you — so plant one thing on purpose. Write an intention and it becomes a seed in a living 3D garden. Water it two minutes a day: read it, breathe with it, picture it as already true. The plant grows across real calendar days, so what you see is what you kept choosing. Free to start, no account, nothing to install. Founders Pro is €29 once — nothing renews, ever.

posts.name: Fumbler
posts.tagline: Dating app with personal description and missed connections
posts.description: It started with the question: "what works on me" Then it became a sort of personal description compendium with selective visibility. It has a share page to work adjacently with other dating apps.

posts.name: HAPS
posts.tagline: Phone and Text Scam Prevention Service
posts.description: HAPS screens every call and text to your parent's phone. The people they know and trust ring straight through. Everyone else is routed to you first — before a scammer ever gets the chance to say hello.
